mapper.sql: id, user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, detail_address, is_default, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shipping_address (user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, detail_address, is_default, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{detailAddress}, #{isDefault}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM shipping_address WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM shipping_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE shipping_address SET receiver_name = #{receiverName}, receiver_phone = #{receiverPhone}, province = #{province}, city = #{city}, detail_address = #{detailAddress}, is_default = #{isDefault} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE shipping_address SET is_default = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE shipping_address SET is_default = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
